item.title: Is herd head expansion going to continue?
item.description: U.S. headline milk production growth was much stronger than expected in September, up 4% compared to the forecast of +3.2%. The only other time that we’ve seen an expansion like this was the mid-1980s, reveals Nate Donnay.

item.title: Wisconsin Cheese launched Wedges of Love
item.description: Presented in keepsake packaging arranged to resemble a bouquet and paired with a personalized poem for the recipient, the collection draws on Wisconsin’s 185-year cheesemaking tradition and reflects the role cheese plays in moments of connection and celebration.

item.title: Hilmar’s David Ahlem and Select Milk Producers’ Mike McCloskey honored with IDFA Laureate Award
item.description: The International Dairy Foods Association (IDFA) recognized the extraordinary leadership of David Ahlem, board advisor and former CEO and president of Hilmar, and Mike McCloskey, co-founder & CEO emeritus of Select Milk Producers, chairman & CEO of Fair Oaks Farms, and founder of fairlife, with the IDFA Laureate Award during the Dairy Forum.

item.title: Häagen-Dazs debuts six new frozen treats, including Dark Cherry Truffle
item.description: Häagen-Dazs debuted a new suite of flavors and products. Anchored by their new Dark Cherry Truffle flavor and Cherry Dark Chocolate bars, the portfolio includes Coffee Almond Toffee and Peanut Butter Brittle in 14-ounce cartons, Toasted Coconut Crunch ice cream bars and Dulce De Leche mini bars.

item.title: Delivery is big business for Smith Brothers Farms
item.description: Our trip to Smith Brothers Farms included two stops: one was a visit to the Kent, Wash., plant, where the company processes milk. Following this visit, we traveled 20 minutes to Federal Way, Wash., to check out the company’s distribution center, the origin of all Smith Brothers Farms’ home delivery services, which is the pillar of many communities.
